narrationTexts: Confirmed pattern: `db.execute({ sql: '...', params: [...] })`. Now I'll migrate the 9 remaining files (skipping the vendored adapter which explicitly says not to edit).
Verifying no `db.query` remains outside the vendored file.
finalText:
**Migrated all 9 remaining files off `db.query`.**

Moved `sla.js`, `macroAdmin.js`, `couponService.js`, `returnService.js`, `teamService.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `refund.js`, `shipment.js`, `session.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, `supplier.js`, and `cohort.js` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

Left [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9) on `db.query`. It's a vendored copy with a comment saying it's replaced wholesale on every upgrade and local edits get lost.

Next: if that vendor package still matters, migrate it upstream instead of here.
